relationship: A transformation is defined by its geometric parameters, and composing transformations can change the image when their order changes.

learnerLoop.action: Set the defining line, centre, vector or scale factor and compare transformation orders.
learnerLoop.modelChange: The image and intermediate image update on the coordinate grid.
learnerLoop.evidence: Corresponding points, grid overlays and calculation checks show whether the defining geometry matches the target.
learnerLoop.nextDecision: Adjust the defining parameter or test whether swapping order changes the result.

invariants: Each transformation preserves the properties specified by its type.
The same ordered sequence gives the same image for every corresponding point.
safeAdaptations: Vary coordinate figures and valid transformation parameters.
Adjust working support while retaining visible source, intermediate and target images.
nonGoals: Assuming transformation compositions commute without testing their order.

task.description: Current transformation goal, stage and route progress.
task.visibility: Shown for the current generated stage.

model.description: Source/target shapes, grid, transformation handles and ordered operation cards.
model.visibility: Present throughout; composition order controls vary by stage.

working.description: Defining parameter entries, angle/order choices and intermediate/final transformation calculations.
working.visibility: Dynamic content follows route, stage and working level.

evidence.description: Point correspondence, invariant readouts, target miss and ordered-operation result show whether the geometry matches.
evidence.visibility: Updates with handle movement, working checks and order changes.

completion.description: Stage completion, route progression and support upgrade.
completion.visibility: Shown only when the stage's visual and working conditions pass.

settings.description: Core/Extended route, working support and stage reset.
settings.visibility: Route and support controls are shown for the current run.

inputs.description: Geometric handles and generated parameter/order fields.
inputs.visibility: Selectors are generated for the active transformation stage.

reflection.description: Mirror line definition and, at All, midpoint/equal-distance evidence.
reflection.domain: Coordinate line or oblique line parameters.

rotation.description: Rotation centre, radius check and signed quarter-turn angle.
rotation.source: Rotation stage handle/choice and generated work fields.
rotation.output: Rotated shape, point correspondence and invariant evidence.

translation.description: Translation vector components Δx and Δy.
translation.source: Translation handle and generated vector work.

enlargement.description: Centre, image vector and signed scale factor for enlargement.
enlargement.source: Enlargement centre/scale handles and generated work.
enlargement.output: Enlarged shape, centre/vector evidence and target miss.

composition-order.description: Intermediate point, final point and resultant/order choice for composition or commuting translations.
composition-order.source: Generated operation cards, order slots and swap action.

modes.core: Core route has reflection, rotation, translation and enlargement stages.
modes.extended: Extended route adds oblique reflection, negative enlargement and composition/commutation order stages.
modes.none: Working level 0 shows the defining calculation while the learner manipulates the geometric model.
modes.some: Working level 1 requires the stage's key result (for example mirror, angle, vector or final point).
modes.all: Working level 2 requires the stage's full generated chain, including invariants or intermediate/resultant values where applicable.

dependencies: Stage completion requires the transformed points to fall within the source visual tolerance and workingReady() to pass for the selected level.
Reflection, rotation, translation and enlargement use stage-specific defining quantities; generated answer keys and visual handles change by stage.
Composition stages require the selected order to match the target; the commute stage additionally requires a swap action before completion.
Completion modal blocks the stage until nextStageBtn/upgrade action advances the route; reset returns the current stage to its initial state.
implementation.completion: The source isStageComplete() combines visualSuccess with workingReady(); the commute stage also requires swapCount>0. When true, #completionLayer/#completionModal opens with next-stage and possible upgrade actions.
limitations: Transformation parameters, operation cards and answer inputs are generated per stage; selectors such as [data-drag] and data-answer keys are state-dependent.
Visual matching uses a point-miss tolerance and stage-specific exact choices, not a general symbolic transformation parser.
